milestones.title: Pinned upstream source library
acceptance: Eight Git submodule commits agree with the lock and actual checkouts
Original upstream licences retained; adoption states explicit

milestones.title: Desktop evidence timeline
acceptance: Searchable chat/caption timeline and source-linked exports
Operator attribution never presented as automatic identification

milestones.title: Durable intelligence API pilot
acceptance: Evidence, cases and assertions survive restart
Atomic idempotency, workspace isolation and damage refusal pass real HTTP/database tests

milestones.title: Agent client transport
acceptance: JavaScript and Python clients query the real scoped API on synthetic evidence
No ALFRED registration or memory-write claim

milestones.title: Complete operator app foundation and design overhaul
acceptance: Coherent React/TypeScript navigation and real overview, sessions, evidence/context, account search, cases/reports and configuration journeys
Explicit authenticated browser transport; broad service credentials remain on the server; existing browser-origin refusal is not replaced by global CORS
Any required case/session read routes are bounded and workspace-bound; existing API clients remain compatible
Useful desktop/community/CRM workflows preserved; loading, empty, pending, failed and unavailable states reflect real service capabilities
Operator browses a retained session, searches evidence, opens context, links a case and previews/exports a report after service restart
Actual desktop and phone browser verification, accessible keyboard navigation, documented reproduction and labelled demo fixtures

milestones.title: Desktop-to-service evidence bridge
acceptance: Explicit operator action archives a real captured timeline
Source versus receipt timestamp basis retained; session IDs do not mix broadcasts
Renderer never holds broad operator credentials
limitations: Native Electron window startup is unverified in the container; archive contract and actual HTTP upload/retry are covered by tests.

milestones.title: Recorder source and licence selection
acceptance: Exact event connector and all direct/transitive runtime licence routes recorded
One selected accessible media source produces available stream URLs without bypassing access controls
remaining: Validate the selected accessible public LIVE and its permitted HTTPS media URL; no usable provider source supplied. Runtime/licence selection is recorded; fixture recording is verified separately.

milestones.title: Durable recorder worker
acceptance: One session has segmented media plus chat and gap records
Durable jobs, stop/retry and restart recovery; recording-active requires written media
limitations: Bounded concurrent Linux workers now support two jobs, workspace quotas and process-fenced leases. Real provider capture remains unverified; this is not a proven customer-scale distributed service.

milestones.title: Independent transcription and diarisation
acceptance: Known-audio evaluation measures text errors, speaker overlap and latency
Speech segments reference media ranges; unidentified tracks remain unknown
remaining: Independent PocketSphinx speech and media-linked anonymous tracks implemented; three known-audio excerpts measured 30% word error rate and 0.256 processing/audio ratio. Multi-speaker overlap and diarisation remain unmeasured; captions are kept separate.

milestones.title: Multi-stream scheduler
acceptance: Two independent sessions collected concurrently without event/identity mixing
Live-status polling, leases, backoff, quotas and durable restart handling
Selected account watchlists discover their available broadcasts; observed guest/chat appearances do not imply a universal room-to-room locator
limitations: Explicit bounded schedules only. Selected account polling/event subscription is implemented and exercised with provider fixtures; no external LIVE or universal account/guest locator was validated.

milestones.title: Intelligence operating console
acceptance: Sessions, worker health, media replay, account activity, evidence and cases use the real API
Desktop and phone browser acceptance; no decorative controls implying unavailable collection
Full application map and design in APP_BLUEPRINT.md: conversation seek/context, evidence bookmarks, account activity, case notes/corrections and consistent navigation

Capture-first default home: selected accounts, explicit bounded discovery/watch, Record/Stop, recording-specific verified replay, rolling captured chat and recent plus older active receipts; review desk remains secondary

milestones.title: Context intelligence and findings
acceptance: Topics, claims, possible incidents and counterevidence reference exact evidence
Human review status preserved; adversarial transcript instructions cannot dispatch tools
Cross-session statement/topic comparisons use captured evidence and distinguish suggested interpretation from original records
remaining: Source-linked findings, support/counterevidence, immutable reviews and literal cross-session comparisons implemented. Optional grounded model proposals are tested against an actual local HTTP fixture; external-provider semantic quality and broad incident detection remain unmeasured.

milestones.title: Source-supported relationship graph
acceptance: Observed, operator-reviewed and inferred links remain distinguishable
Account identity, speaker track and real-world person are distinct objects

milestones.title: Protection missions and alerts
acceptance: Protected account, selected sources, rules and delivery preferences belong to one workspace
Reviewed/uncertain alerts show source context and capture gaps
limitations: Rules evaluate literal terms plus protected-account/context checks on retained evidence. In-app delivery is implemented; external notifications and broad threat-classifier quality are not configured or claimed.

milestones.title: Reviewed reports and evidence packs
acceptance: Report editor, redaction, PDF/JSON evidence bundle and retained source manifests
Every material finding has sources and review history
limitations: JSON evidence packs contain original hash/source/media receipts rather than embedding media files. Redacted copies preserve originals and mask dependent text; persistent identifiers, paraphrases and media still require review before sharing.

milestones.title: Registered ALFRED read interface
acceptance: Dedicated ALFRED HTTP adapter respects source/model grants and workspace binding
Revocation, unavailable service, token rotation and untrusted content acceptance tests
limitations: Actual optional ALFRED authenticated HTTP/CLI tools are implemented/tested on branch feat/livelens-tools-2026-10-11, commit 5b37ba41353cfcd0cae4243482520e25175e21d9, draft PR #20; unmerged and undeployed. Explicit private installation and current grants are required; publishing code does not connect a user host.

Configured fixture proof: 36/36 actual HTTP/CLI transport checks, six-second generated capture with three hashed/independently decoded segments; 1128 ALFRED backend tests and 58 browser checks pass locally. Hosted CI was pending at publication; no external LIVE, NLP automatic tool invocation, tool-board UI, model call or automatic memory acceptance is claimed.

Traceable job receipt; memory acceptance never automatic

Explicit private installation and current grants are required; publishing code does not connect a user host.

Hosted CI was pending at publication; no external LIVE, NLP automatic tool invocation, tool-board UI, model call or automatic memory acceptance is claimed.

milestones.title: Paid pilot infrastructure
acceptance: PostgreSQL/object storage/queue deployment validated
Case permissions, encryption, retention/deletion, metering, billing and backup recovery
Measured capacity and failure budget before customer rollout
Customer login, teams/roles and case-level permissions are enforced at the server; invited customer pilot precedes wider rollout
Representative app-user load, recording concurrency and speech/analysis concurrency measured separately, with explicit latency, queue, storage and cost budgets
Hundreds-of-users ambition remains a target until capacity and failure/recovery results support a stated service limit
remaining: Optional PostgreSQL pilot-schema bridge tested on actual PostgreSQL 17.6; encrypted object archival and explicit restoration tested on local filesystem and signed S3 HTTP fixture. Target PostgreSQL RLS/queue migration, external object deployment, public self-service signup, payment-provider integration, representative customer load and production rollout remain outstanding. Local SQLite backup recovery is tested; PostgreSQL production backup operations need their own receipt.

milestones.title: Additional source platforms
acceptance: A second permitted platform uses the same event/media contracts
Independent provider failures and credentials isolated
remaining: Direct permitted HTTPS media adapter implemented alongside selected TikTok-public adapter. A second named platform and external provider failure/credential behavior have not been validated.

productTarget.application: Capture-first browser LIVE monitor: selected accounts, bounded checks/watch schedules, explicit Record/Stop, retained video with chat and recent recordings; review/investigation secondary, existing desktop/community workflows preserved
productTarget.growth: Private operator app, invited customer pilot, then measured server operation towards hundreds of users
productTarget.designAcceptance: Capture-first monitor replaces review-first home at owner request; prior functional receipts do not establish final visual acceptance
productTarget.communityBoundary: Native Electron CRM preserved with local fan records; browser page bridge is a development demo, not shared-server CRM
